title: The Deal
description: Desperate to bring back her little sister, Dina enters a moonless forest to complete her side of a dangerous bargain with an unseen entity.
excerpt: Dina has made the required sacrifices. Now, deep within a moonless forest, she must discover whether the entity she bargained with will honour its side of the deal.
author: from-a-storyteller
